chars.SHAMS: SHAMS: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow hooded jacket, black jeans and a dark red scarf around her neck.
chars.DOC: DOCTOR: a middle-aged man wearing a stained wrinkled white doctor coat over a brown sweater, thick black square glasses, grey stubble.
chars.MAMA: MAMA: an older woman wearing a light blue djellaba and a white headscarf.
chars.REC: RECEPTIONIST: a stern woman wearing a purple djellaba and a black headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At night in a narrow dim alley of an old Moroccan medina in Casablanca, SHAMS stands tense and scared holding her belly, facing the shady DOCTOR who stands in a half-open old wooden door and stretches out his open hand asking for money, suspicious look. Open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SHAMS sits on her bed in a small Moroccan bedroom at night, lit by her phone screen, reading messages with a worried, determined face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan family home, SHAMS sneaks out through the front door with a guilty look while MAMA in the kitchen behind her cooks a tajine, unaware, back turned.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SHAMS walks alone up to an old shabby apartment building in a poor Casablanca neighbourhood, peeling paint, dark stairwell entrance, she hesitates afraid.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a dim cramped hallway, the stern RECEPTIONIST blocks a door with her arm and interrogates SHAMS angrily, pointing at her; SHAMS steps back, scared.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SHAMS sits alone by the window in an old Moroccan intercity bus, staring outside at a dry landscape, anxious, hand on her belly.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the door of a shady small clinic, the DOCTOR takes a thick wad of banknotes from SHAMS's hand, greedy smile; SHAMS looks frightened.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In a dirty dim improvised clinic room with a rusty metal examination bed and an old lamp, SHAMS sits on the bed shivering wrapped in a thin sheet, terrified; the DOCTOR stands beside her coldly pulling on gloves.
